content: Testcontainers Java 2.0.0 released 2025-10-14, latest 2.0.5 (2026-04-20, GitHub releases API). 2.x renames Maven artifactIds to testcontainers-<module> prefix (e.g. org.testcontainers:testcontainers-clickhouse) and drops JUnit4; Java package imports unchanged. 1.21.4 (used by this project) remains a valid, still-published artifact; no functional need to upgrade for ClickHouse latest + client V2 support which already works on 1.21.4.
